commonPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Primary request: transform the supplied homepage visual into ONE fully designed desktop WEB PRODUCT DETAIL PAGE for the same Chinese assessment marketplace. This is a new page design derived from the existing page shell, not a homepage. Render a SINGLE finished page in each image, never a collage. 
Input images: Image 1 is the source design and exact style/shell reference: match its brand wordmark, colors, navigation, glass borders, card radii, typography and decorative lighting. Image 2 is the product cover artwork/material reference: lavender translucent glass ribbon and clear floating sphere. Do not change or overwrite either original file.
Brand: use the latest exact lowercase wordmark "meetmyworld" and a simple lavender outlined round m/w symbol similar to Image 1.
Output composition: full-page desktop browser-content screenshot, straight-on flat frontal view, logical canvas 1440 px wide by 1600 px tall, vertical page scroll implied. Show the entire composition including bottom sections, edges uncropped. No browser chrome, device frame, perspective, Figma editor UI, annotations or labels outside the website.
Visual style: carefully match Image 1. Near-black #101117 page background, graphite #1B1D27 glass surfaces, lavender primary #D5A7EE, restrained pale purple, ice blue, mint and blush for illustrations, white heading text, muted gray body text, hairline silver-gray outlines, subtle purple outer corner glow and sage-green lower-left outer glow. Large 20–28px radii, pill controls, Noto Sans SC style Chinese UI typography, Manrope-like Latin wordmark. Spacious professional interface, consistent icons and grid, thin orbital wireframe curves only in low-contrast background. Decorative artwork must be confined to cover/cards, never compete with text.
Shared shell: full-width 72px header with brand at left, a compact search field center labeled "搜索测试、场景或关键词", then "我的空间" and a lavender "登录 / 注册" pill at right. Left sidebar about 224px inside a continuous translucent rounded shell: heading "我的空间"; links "应用商城" highlighted, "我的应用", "我的报告", "使用帮助"; lower small "输入兑换码" button. Main content to its right, about 1040px wide with 32px padding.
Product state: unclaimed sample product. Subtle small badge "演示商品 · 暂不开放购买". Price is "参考价 ¥9.9". No real sales or clinical claims.
Exact product copy, render clean readable Simplified Chinese:
breadcrumb "应用商城 / 关系情感 / 伴侣协作体检"
back link "返回商城"
category badge "关系情感"
title "伴侣协作体检"
hook "你找的是队友，还是第二份工作？"
summary "从日常分工、承诺与沟通中，看见你们的协作方式。"
metadata pills "16 道题" "约 3 分钟" "5 个维度"
primary CTA "输入兑换码"
secondary CTA "查看购买说明"
small CTA note "无需登录，也能兑换与查看报告"
section "测评介绍"
body "围绕共同生活中的具体场景，整理你眼中的关系协作倾向。"
section "你将了解什么"
five concise dimension chips "家务主动性" "承诺兑现" "共同决策" "沟通修复" "边界尊重"
section "报告样例"
badge "示意"
sample result title "协作型队友"
small radar or horizontal bars for those five dimensions, visibly illustrative only; caption "样例数据，不代表真实测评结果". This is a public sample, not a private report.
section "购买与兑换说明"
steps "平台购买" "获取兑换码" "输入兑换码" "完成测评"
small explanatory copy "在购买平台获得兑换码后，回到这里领取测评。"
terms "使用期限以兑换权益为准"
section "你可能也感兴趣"
three compact recommendation cards using the source homepage's pastel glass artwork aesthetics, titles "职场隐形加班体检" "关系脑补倾向" "社交电量说明书"
footer disclaimer "趣味自测，仅供娱乐与自我观察。"
Constraints: clear product detail page hierarchy, readable unclipped Chinese text, visibly clickable redemption CTA; price displayed once in purchase/overview area. Do not repeat the huge homepage slogan. No cart, checkout, credit card, on-site payment, fake QR codes, star reviews, invented user counts, fake popularity, countdown scarcity, creator portal, AI chat or clinical accuracy claims. Do not show a complete questionnaire or actual personal results. Default primary CTA remains 输入兑换码; no pre-redemption 开始测评 button. All four alternatives must keep identical brand, product and business flow.

variants.name: 左右双栏
variants.directions: Layout variant A — CLASSIC TWO-COLUMN, closest continuation of the source homepage. Within main content, breadcrumbs and back link at top. Hero is a balanced 440px-high two-column card: left roughly 42% a tall lavender pastel product cover with the large flowing glass ribbon and floating sphere; right roughly 58% graphite information panel with category badge, large title, hook, summary, metadata pills, reference price, prominent full-width lavender 输入兑换码 pill and outlined 查看购买说明 below. Below hero use an approximately 60/40 two-column row: introduction and five dimensions on the left; compact clearly labeled report sample card with an illustrative radar on the right. Then a wide four-step purchase/redemption strip, then three recommendation cards and footer. Keep source left sidebar and precise dark glass styling. No giant masthead.
